plugins.name: Audiobooks
plugins.description: Public-domain audiobooks from LibriVox: search the catalogue, pull a book into your library, and pick up where you left off.
plugins.author: AttackFM

plugins.name: EQ rack
plugins.description: A preset rack for the equalizer: save your own curves, flip between A and B, and land any of them in one tap.
plugins.author: AttackFM

plugins.name: Gig radar
plugins.description: Upcoming shows from the artists in your library, with a filter for your corner of the world and tickets one tap away.
plugins.author: AttackFM

plugins.name: Library tools
plugins.description: A toolbox of library janitor tools: fix album art, repair tags, merge duplicates, see where the disk went, and back up your playlists.
plugins.author: AttackFM

plugins.name: Rabbit hole
plugins.description: Follow the map: start at an artist you love and walk the catalogue's neighbours hop by hop, marking what you already own.
plugins.author: AttackFM

plugins.name: Smart playlists
plugins.description: Rule-built playlists that keep themselves current: genre, artist, freshness, duration - you write the rule, the list follows the library.
plugins.author: AttackFM

plugins.name: Music import
plugins.description: Downloads pasted Spotify, Apple Music, Tidal, Deezer, YT Music, and Qobuz links into the library.
plugins.author: AttackFM

plugins.name: Time machine
plugins.description: Around this date, years ago: what you had on repeat then, playable now - your own listening history as a place to visit.
plugins.author: AttackFM

plugins.name: Undercurrent
plugins.description: Ambience under the music: rain, vinyl crackle, fireplace, and wind, synthesized on the spot - no recordings, just a mixer.
plugins.author: AttackFM
